name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS) - Tamil Nadu
authority: Government of Tamil Nadu / United India Insurance
shortDescription: State welfare scheme offering health assurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a family-floater basis across empanelled network hospitals in Tamil Nadu.
summary: State welfare scheme offering health assurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year.

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Annual family income less than ₹1,20,000 per year (certified by revenue authority)
eligibilityCriteria.verificationNote: Updated threshold of ₹1.2 lakh confirmed from Tamil Nadu Health Department notification (checked 2026-10-13)

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Eligible family members listed on the official Tamil Nadu Family Ration Card
eligibilityCriteria.verificationNote: Confirmed: family floater covers spouse, children, and dependent parents listed on the card

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: TO VERIFY: Specific specialized procedures exceeding ₹5 lakh requiring special corpus approval

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
authority: National Health Authority (NHA) / MoHFW, Government of India
shortDescription: Centrally sponsored health assurance scheme providing ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to bottom 40% vulnerable population.
summary: Centrally sponsored health assurance scheme providing ₹5,00,000 per family per year.

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Deprived rural households or identified urban occupational categories mapped under SECC 2011 database
eligibilityCriteria.verificationNote: Confirmed from NHA guidelines on 2026-10-13: D1-D7 rural deprivation and 11 urban worker categories

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: All Senior Citizens aged 70 years and above irrespective of economic status (expanded provision)
eligibilityCriteria.verificationNote: Confirmed via official Union Cabinet expansion notifications (checked 2026-10-13)

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Biometric / OTP Aadhaar e-KYC completed at Common Service Centre (CSC) or Ayushman Mitra kiosk
TO VERIFY: State-specific convergence package matching between CMCHIS and PM-JAY in Tamil Nadu
eligibilityCriteria.verificationNote: State Health Agency Tamil Nadu dual-card package rates change periodically; requires verification

requiredDocuments: Ration Card / PM-JAY Family ID / Ration card showing household linkage
Active mobile number linked to Aadhaar

name: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN)
authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), Government of India
shortDescription: One-time financial assistance grant up to ₹15,00,000 for Below Poverty Line (BPL) patients suffering from major life-threatening diseases receiving treatment in Government super-speciality hospitals.
summary: One-time financial assistance grant up to ₹15,00,000 for BPL patients in Government hospitals.

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Patients living Below Poverty Line (BPL) certified by state revenue authorities
eligibilityCriteria.verificationNote: Confirmed from MoHFW RAN Scheme Guidelines (checked 2026-10-13)

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Suffering from major life-threatening disease (cardiology, oncology, nephrology, liver diseases)
eligibilityCriteria.verificationNote: Confirmed from MoHFW Technical Committee Guidelines (checked 2026-10-13)

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Treatment strictly in participating Government super-speciality hospitals / Regional Cancer Centres (Private hospitals not eligible)
eligibilityCriteria.verificationNote: Confirmed: grants disbursed directly to Government Medical Superintendent (checked 2026-10-13)

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: TO VERIFY: Specific state revolving fund spending caps and fast-track clearance thresholds
